comment: 2026-09-20 regeneration (flow-based network verdicts, ADR-056; sp4rk tools/shellanalysis.go + flowsh flow model). The cradle criterion C5 is now keyed on the PROVEN network->code-execution flow (cradleFlows) and the new C7 command_external_content_ingest on the network->filesystem ingress flow (ingestFlows): the old unbounded-and-net-egress co-occurrence + host-evidence rule is gone, so a read-only stdout fetch (event 966284, curl ... | head) fires NO criterion and the deterministic stub ALLOWS it -- the phantom-C5 incident is fixed on the deterministic layer. The two curl -o persisted fetches (964976/965136) stay denied through the new hard non-canonical C7. Digest v3 (sp4rk-shell-analysis/v3). Stub-model cross-tab (deterministic stub judge: ALLOW iff marker OR no hard criteria): TD 8/8 must-stay-denied hold, FD 14 (tracks A=8 B=6 C=0 D=0), TA-denied 26/143, FA 0 -> deny-precision 0.364, allow-recall 0.818. The remaining FD/TA are the documented deterministic-stub gaps the recommendations forbid blanket-clearing (section 4): benign git-pipelines / inline awk / shell while-read loops / git-show+shasum (still top/conservative), inline-python/sqlite3 code-exec sinks, out-of-root reads the marker excludes by design, and the new hard non-canonical C7 ingest the fail-closed-on-arbitrary-host stub cannot clear (e.g. 967273, an arxiv PDF download whose host the real judge can establish as authoritative). NOTE: this regeneration also un-models golangci-lint in the flowsh KB (kb/data/linting.yaml) -- the workspace-scoped verification marker already TOLERATES an unresolved verification driver (a top CodeExec is the unknown-driver signature its top-on-CodeExec-only rule admits), so 12 of the 14 golangci-lint corpus events stay TRUE_ALLOW via the marker while the one audited TRUE_DENY shape that rewrites the module graph (GOFLAGS=-mod=mod plus a go.work write, event 966665) keeps escalating; modelling the binary had silently cleared the marker there and lost a TRUE_DENY (its retirement also kept event 967978, a lint-output-to-/tmp shape, in its place as the +1 track-B FD). Section 5 table (A -13, B -24, C -4) is the REAL-judge model; section 6.2 hard thresholds (deny-precision >= 0.80, allow-recall = 1.0) are NOT enforced with this stub (FD 967229 python3 repo script vs TD 967493/969396/969419 python3 temp scripts are deterministically indistinguishable without script content -- Track E or the real judge is required); flip final_thresholds_enforced only after such a doctrine lands. Regenerate after a track lands: SILENT_CORPUS_REGEN_SNAPSHOT=1 go test ./core/tools -run TestSilentCorpus_Replay
